paragraphs.text: Rael was a Garan Elf living in Tamingazin , part of Otaria on the plane of Dominaria . After he was promoted to rank gar, his name was changed from Rael Tak to Rael Gar .

Rael had the distinctive sharp-chinned face, pale skin, and wide eyes of a Garan , his eyes a hard cold silver and his hair brown and curly. He was studiously emotionless, managing to avoid most of the Garan emotion-colors in his eyes. Though short, Rael had an almost impossibly broad chest and every inch of his body was corded with muscle. He wore soft black clothing and a loose hood.

Rael was a Garan Tak when the Garan went through a brutal winter. Janin , the gar, led the Garan west, where they encountered hundreds of En'Jaga and were slaughtered. Her husband Ranas snuck out each night to kill En'Jaga with a crossbow until he was followed, caught, and killed by Rael. Janin fled south to Berimish , and Rael became the new gar.

Rael became part of the army of Tagard Tarngold , working as his advisor alongside Karelon . Despite his apparent lack of emotions, he was a violent and bloodthirsty man, making Talli feel unsafe around him, and openly wanting to kill fellow Recin when he encountered her in Berimish. After working hard to get Recin and his mother Janin and aunt Getin executed, Rael was part of a meeting of the Council where Karelon revealed her plans for another coup. She had secretly drugged Rael's food and drink, so when he attacked her, his reflexes were dulled enough for her to stab him in his chest, killing him instantly.
